title: Synthetic Test Practice - Original Test Data

questions.passage: Mira moved a library notice from a side wall to the entrance. During the next week, more visitors asked about the event described in the notice.
questions.prompt: Which conclusion is best supported by the text?
options: The new location may have helped visitors notice the event.
The notice described a different library.
questions.explanation: Original synthetic test item: more questions followed the move to a more visible location; the text does not establish attendance.

questions.passage: A town installed a small rain gauge in its public garden. Volunteers record its reading at noon each day, creating a consistent record of local rainfall.
questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the volunteers' daily readings?
options: To predict the exact weather for the next year
To collect comparable observations over time
To keep visitors out of the garden
To replace all measurements of temperature
questions.explanation: Original synthetic test item: using the same daily measurement time supports a consistent record.
